tools.name: catalog.list_tools
tools.description:
Enumerate every tool exposed by every connected server, with its server, family and one-line summary. Reading the catalogue is a discovery operation, not a data operation.

Returns: An array of {name, server, family, summary} objects.

server.description: Restrict the listing to a single server name.

family.description: Restrict the listing to a single tool family.

tools.name: catalog.describe_tool
tools.description:
Return the full schema and long description of one tool, including the caveats that distinguish it from its siblings in the same family.

Returns: A single tool descriptor object.

name.description: Fully qualified tool name, for example 'rota.get_effective_oncall'.

tools.name: catalog.search_tools
tools.description:
Free-text search across tool names, summaries and descriptions. Returns ranked candidates; it does not choose for you.

Returns: A ranked array of tool descriptors.

tools.name: rota.list_shifts
tools.description:
List the shifts published in the rotation template for a service and window. The template is authored weeks in advance and is NOT updated when a shift is swapped, overridden or covered; it shows who was originally scheduled.

Returns: An array of template shift rows.

tools.name: rota.get_nominal_shift
tools.description:
Return the single template shift covering an instant. Reflects the published rotation only; approved overrides, swaps and escalation-policy failovers are not applied.

Returns: One template shift row.

at_utc.description: Instant to look up, RFC 3339 UTC.

tools.name: rota.get_effective_oncall
tools.description:
Return who was actually on call for a service at an instant, after applying every approved override, swap and coverage record on top of the published rotation. This is the resolved answer, not the template.

Returns: An object with handle, role, escalation_tier, source_of_truth and the override chain that was applied.

tools.name: rota.search_rota
tools.description:
Free-text search over rotation names and shift comments. Matches text, not time; it cannot tell you who is on call.

Returns: An array of matching rotation rows.

tools.name: rota.get_escalation_policy
tools.description:
Return the escalation policy attached to a service: the ordered tiers and the wait before each hop.

Returns: An escalation policy object.

tools.name: rota.get_handover_notes
tools.description:
Return free-text handover notes written at the end of a shift.

Returns: An array of notes.

tools.name: rota.list_rotations
tools.description:
List every rotation configured for a service, including retired ones.

Returns: An array of rotation descriptors.

tools.name: directory.get_person_by_handle
tools.description:
Resolve a chat handle to exactly one current person record: legal name, team, location and employment status. Handles are unique and never reassigned.

Returns: One person record.

tools.name: directory.search_people
tools.description:
Fuzzy search over names, handles and aliases. Returns every match including former staff and duplicate records created by past migrations; ranking is by string similarity only.

Returns: An array of candidate person records.

tools.name: directory.lookup_person
tools.description:
Look up a person by internal numeric person_id. Returns the record as it stood at the last directory sync, which may lag the live system by up to 24 hours.

Returns: One person record from the last sync.

tools.name: directory.get_person_by_email
tools.description:
Resolve a corporate email address to a person record. Aliases and forwarding addresses are not resolved.

Returns: One person record.

tools.name: directory.get_team
tools.description:
Return a team record: name, cost centre, parent team and the handle of its manager.

Returns: One team record.

tools.name: directory.list_team_members
tools.description:
List the members of a team.

Returns: An array of person records.

tools.name: directory.get_manager_chain
tools.description:
Return the management chain above a person, root last.

Returns: An ordered array of person records.

tools.name: directory.get_contact_methods
tools.description:
Return the contact methods registered for a person.

Returns: An array of contact-method objects.

tools.name: registry.get_tag_digest
tools.description:
Return the image digest that a tag pointed to **at the moment the tag was first published**. This value is recorded once at publish time and is never rewritten, so it is stale for any tag that has since been moved to a newer build.

Returns: An object with repository, tag, digest and published_at.

tools.name: registry.resolve_digest_pinned
tools.description:
Resolve a tag to the digest it points to **right now**, following any tag moves. This is the digest that will be pulled today.

Returns: An object with repository, tag, digest, resolved_at and whether the tag has been moved since publication.

tools.name: registry.search_images
tools.description:
Free-text search over repository names and image labels. Returns repositories, not digests.

Returns: An array of repository descriptors.

tools.name: registry.list_tags
tools.description:
List every tag in a repository with its last push time.

Returns: An array of tag rows.

tools.name: registry.list_repositories
tools.description:
List repositories visible to the caller.

Returns: An array of repository names.

prefix.description: Restrict to repositories under a path prefix.

tools.name: registry.get_image_manifest
tools.description:
Return the OCI manifest for a digest.

Returns: A manifest object.

tools.name: registry.get_image_sbom
tools.description:
Return the software bill of materials attached to a digest.

Returns: An SBOM summary object.

tools.name: registry.get_repository_policy
tools.description:
Return the retention and signing policy for a repository.

Returns: A policy object.

tools.name: vulndb.get_image_findings_by_digest
tools.description:
Return the vulnerability findings for one exact image digest, from the most recent completed scan of that digest. Findings are bound to the digest, so this answer does not change when a tag is moved.

Returns: An object with digest, scan_completed_at and an array of findings.

digest.description: Image digest, including the algorithm prefix.

min_severity.description: Lowest severity to include: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH or CRITICAL.

tools.name: vulndb.get_image_findings_by_tag
tools.description:
Return the findings cached against a tag. The cache is written the first time a tag is scanned and is not invalidated when the tag is moved, so it may describe a digest that the tag no longer points to.

Returns: An object with repository, tag, cached_for_digest and an array of findings.

tools.name: vulndb.search_advisories
tools.description:
Free-text search of the advisory database. Returns advisories, not the findings for any particular image.

Returns: An array of advisory summaries.

tools.name: vulndb.get_advisory
tools.description:
Return one advisory by identifier, including CVSS vector and affected ranges.

Returns: An advisory object.

tools.name: vulndb.get_fix_versions
tools.description:
Return the package versions in which an advisory is fixed, per distribution.

Returns: An array of fix rows.

tools.name: vulndb.get_kev_status
tools.description:
Return whether an advisory is listed as known-exploited.

Returns: A status object.

tools.name: vulndb.list_severities
tools.description:
Return the severity bands used by this database and their CVSS ranges.

Returns: An array of band objects.

tools.name: fiscal.convert_calendar_to_fiscal
tools.description:
Convert a calendar date into the company fiscal calendar, returning fiscal year, fiscal quarter and fiscal period. The company fiscal year does not start on 1 January and periods follow a 4-4-5 week pattern, so fiscal quarters do not line up with calendar quarters.

Returns: An object with fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, fiscal_period and the period start and end dates.

tools.name: fiscal.get_fiscal_quarter
tools.description:
Return the fiscal quarter that contains a date, without the period detail.

Returns: An object with fiscal_year and fiscal_quarter.

tools.name: fiscal.get_fiscal_year
tools.description:
Return only the fiscal year containing a date.

Returns: An object with fiscal_year.

tools.name: fiscal.list_fiscal_periods
tools.description:
List every fiscal period in a fiscal year with its start, end and close dates.

Returns: An array of period rows.

tools.name: fiscal.get_period_close_date
tools.description:
Return the ledger close date for one fiscal period.

Returns: An object with close_date and whether the period is already closed.

tools.name: fiscal.get_fiscal_calendar_definition
tools.description:
Return the definition of a fiscal calendar: the year start rule and the period pattern.

Returns: A calendar definition object.

tools.name: calendar.get_calendar_quarter
tools.description:
Return the ordinary calendar quarter containing a date, where Q1 is January to March. This has no relationship to any fiscal calendar.

Returns: An object with year and quarter.

tools.name: calendar.get_iso_week
tools.description:
Return the ISO-8601 week number and weekday for a date.

Returns: An object with iso_year, iso_week and iso_weekday.

tools.name: calendar.get_month_boundaries
tools.description:
Return the first and last calendar day of the month containing a date.

Returns: An object with month_start and month_end.

tools.name: calendar.add_business_days
tools.description:
Add a number of business days to a date using a named holiday calendar.

Returns: An object with the resulting date.

tools.name: calendar.is_business_day
tools.description:
Return whether a date is a business day in a named holiday calendar.

Returns: An object with is_business_day.

tools.name: calendar.diff_days
tools.description:
Return the number of days between two dates.

Returns: An object with days.

tools.name: calendar.get_holidays
tools.description:
List the holidays in a named calendar for a year.

Returns: An array of holiday rows.

tools.name: billing.get_invoice
tools.description:
Return one invoice in full, including the order reference, the ship date recorded by the fulfilment system, the billing date and every line item. The ship date and the billing date are different fields and frequently differ.

Returns: A complete invoice object.

order_id.description: Order identifier; either invoice_id or order_id must be supplied.

tools.name: billing.list_invoices
tools.description:
List invoice summary rows for an account. Summary rows carry the billing date only; they do not carry the ship date and they do not carry line items.

Returns: An array of invoice summary rows.

tools.name: billing.search_orders
tools.description:
Free-text search over order references and customer purchase-order numbers. Returns order stubs without dates.

Returns: An array of order stubs.

tools.name: billing.get_effective_rate_card
tools.description:
Return the rate card in force for an account on a date, after applying contract-specific overrides.

Returns: A rate card object.

tools.name: billing.get_rate_card
tools.description:
Return a published standard rate card by identifier. Contract-specific overrides are not applied.

Returns: A rate card object.

tools.name: billing.get_account_balance
tools.description:
Return the current balance for an account.

Returns: A balance object.

tools.name: billing.list_credits
tools.description:
List credits applied to an account.

Returns: An array of credit rows.

tools.name: billing.get_usage_summary
tools.description:
Return metered usage for an account and month.

Returns: A usage summary object.

tools.name: tickets.get_effective_sla
tools.description:
Return the service level actually binding on a ticket, after applying the customer's contract overrides, the severity at which the ticket is currently classified, and any agreed suspension windows. This is the target the ticket is measured against.

Returns: An object with response_target_minutes, resolution_target_minutes, clock_stopped_minutes and the source of each value.

tools.name: tickets.get_ticket_sla
tools.description:
Return the default service level published for the queue a ticket sits in. Contract overrides, reclassification and suspension windows are not applied.

Returns: An object with the queue default targets.

tools.name: tickets.get_queue
tools.description:
Return a queue definition, including its published default service levels.

Returns: A queue object.

tools.name: tickets.get_ticket
tools.description:
Return one ticket: status, severity, timestamps, requester and account.

Returns: A ticket object.

tools.name: tickets.list_ticket_events
tools.description:
Return the ordered event log for a ticket.

Returns: An array of event rows.

tools.name: tickets.search_tickets
tools.description:
Free-text search over ticket subjects and bodies.

Returns: An array of ticket stubs.

tools.name: tickets.list_linked_tickets
tools.description:
Return tickets linked to a ticket.

Returns: An array of ticket stubs.

tools.name: metrics.get_error_budget_after_exclusions
tools.description:
Return the remaining error budget for a service and month after removing every approved exclusion window, such as agreed maintenance and incidents accepted as out of scope. This is the figure the service level is reported against.

Returns: An object with budget_minutes_total, consumed_minutes, excluded_minutes, remaining_minutes and the exclusions applied.

tools.name: metrics.get_error_budget
tools.description:
Return the raw remaining error budget for a service and month computed from measured unavailability alone. No approved exclusion window is removed.

Returns: An object with budget_minutes_total, consumed_minutes and remaining_minutes.

tools.name: metrics.get_slo
tools.description:
Return the service level objective configured for a service: the target and the measurement window.

Returns: An SLO object.

tools.name: metrics.query_timeseries
tools.description:
Run a range query against the metrics store.

Returns: A time-series result object.

tools.name: metrics.get_alert_state
tools.description:
Return the current state of an alert rule.

Returns: An alert state object.

tools.name: metrics.list_dashboards
tools.description:
List dashboards for a service.

Returns: An array of dashboard descriptors.

tools.name: inventory.get_stock_level_with_reservations
tools.description:
Return the quantity of a part that can actually be promised at a warehouse: physical stock minus quantity already reserved against open orders, minus quarantined stock.

Returns: An object with on_hand, reserved, quarantined and available_to_promise.

tools.name: inventory.get_stock_level
tools.description:
Return the physical count of a part at a warehouse as last counted. Reservations against open orders and quarantined stock are not deducted.

Returns: An object with on_hand and counted_at.

tools.name: inventory.search_parts
tools.description:
Free-text search over part numbers and descriptions.

Returns: An array of part stubs.

tools.name: inventory.get_part
tools.description:
Return a part record.

Returns: A part object.

tools.name: inventory.get_reorder_point
tools.description:
Return the reorder point and lead time for a part at a warehouse.

Returns: A reorder policy object.

tools.name: inventory.get_supplier
tools.description:
Return the supplier record for a part.

Returns: A supplier object.

tools.name: inventory.list_warehouses
tools.description:
List warehouses.

Returns: An array of warehouse records.

tools.name: geo.get_region_for_site
tools.description:
Return the operating region a site belongs to.

Returns: A region object.

tools.name: geo.geocode
tools.description:
Convert a postal address into coordinates.

Returns: A coordinate object.

tools.name: geo.reverse_geocode
tools.description:
Convert coordinates into the nearest postal address.

Returns: An address object.

tools.name: geo.get_timezone
tools.description:
Return the IANA time zone for coordinates.

Returns: A time zone object.

tools.name: geo.distance_between
tools.description:
Return the great-circle distance between two sites in kilometres.

Returns: A distance object.

tools.name: docs.get_latest_revision
tools.description:
Return the current published revision of a document, which is the revision in force today.

Returns: A revision object with body and revision label.

tools.name: docs.get_document_revision
tools.description:
Return one named historical revision of a document. Superseded revisions are retained and are not marked as such in the body.

Returns: A revision object.

tools.name: docs.get_document
tools.description:
Return a document header: title, owner, collection and revision list. The body is not included.

Returns: A document header object.

tools.name: docs.search_documents
tools.description:
Free-text search across document bodies in every revision, including superseded ones.

Returns: An array of search hits.

tools.name: docs.list_collections
tools.description:
List document collections.

Returns: An array of collection records.
